long_biography.plain_text:
The Rühl Group gives Andreas Erich Heinrich Rühl his defining role as a second-generation industrial owner in Friedrichsdorf. The family enterprise began with bicarbonate of soda after the Second World War and developed into a specialist chemical manufacturer. Rühl now leads the owner-managed business alongside Johann Heyken, keeping control within a privately held medium-sized group.

Its divisions solve markedly different technical problems. One develops tailored polyurethane systems for components used in furniture, construction and vehicles; another makes fire-extinguishing powders, foams and liquids. A third produces cleaning and disinfection products, including formulations for hospital instruments. The breadth of those operations reflects the group’s shift from a single household chemical to specialised materials and safety products.
